detection_policy.anchor: Use the Phantom thumb-index aperture closure minimum when it is observable and consistent with RGB contact.
detection_policy.association: Associate each hand with the manipulated SAM3D object by RGB review.
detection_policy.boundary: Use Phantom closure/hysteresis as a temporal proposal, then require RGB-visible hand-object contact. Correct boundaries where the clip starts in contact or Phantom disagrees with visible contact/release.
detection_policy.frame_semantics: Inclusive start, anchor, and end frame indices.

interactions.evidence: Phantom closes earlier while the hand is still off-object. RGB shows first board contact at frame 26 and a stable edge grasp by frame 30; frame 124 is the last visible contact.
Phantom closes before object contact. RGB shows first handle contact at frame 22, a stable grasp by frame 30, and last visible contact at frame 132.
Phantom aperture closes from frames 8-14; RGB confirms handle contact. Phantom hysteresis begins at frame 0 spuriously.
RGB begins with the brush already grasped, so no closure onset is observable. Frame 63 is the last visible contact; the Phantom minimum near frame 65 occurs after release.
